correctness.rationale: In the Fano-incidence graph with edges j−i∈{0,2,3} mod 7, independent enumeration of all allowed permutations establishes 24 perfect matchings. Directly testing every subset of the fixed diagonal matching against every other matching shows a subset is locally forcing precisely when excluded from all seven four-edge common-intersection blocks B_t={e_t,e_{t+1},e_{t+3},e_{t+5}}. Independent subset counts yielded sizes 3:14,4:28,5:21,6:7,7:1 and no forcing smaller subset. The submitted verifier explicitly builds the 168 linear collineations and bipartition duality for 336 automorphisms and tests that 336 minimum triples form two 168-element orbits; its finite certificate was read, but independent automorphism enumeration was not reexecuted in this audit.
